scope: Early learning 3-6, pedagogy and storybook UI; local source and database migration

checks.check: Age-specific teaching guide reads actual lesson vocabulary
Child and unrelated teacher cannot create observations
Real BSON observation and image persist once; retries and conflicting reuse are enforced
Family sees its own evidence; private image requires authorization and cannot leak to another child
End-of-Unit board derives support level from actual teacher observations
Ending a partial lesson preserves curriculum position
Complete requires all taught goals; ending retries advance curriculum only once
Full backup 3.3 includes private evidence in BSON Extended JSON and passes restore preflight
Only the author or admin can void evidence; family, media, and Unit board omit it and retries cannot resurrect it

issues.detail: prior completion preserved; no missing activity results invented

browser.mode: Chrome isolated, read-only app fixtures; real public artwork and game engines

limitations: Chrome UI checks use read-only sample fixtures; real API persistence is tested in a separate MongoDB database.
No classroom trial or cross-device microphone validation was performed.
Media preloading does not make login, navigation or all lessons available offline.
Age defaults and review intervals are teaching heuristics, not a validated developmental assessment.
